overview_description.description: Zoftware is a software discovery platform that connects businesses to software companies using generative and predictive AI. They significantly simplify the decision-making and evaluation process for selecting a software product by clearly understanding business requirements through advanced search algorithms. They provide detailed product information, including price, demos, screenshots, local presence, client ratings, and more.
